const m = /^Bearer\s+(.+)$/i.exec(($json.headers || {}).authorization || '');
return [{ json: m ? { token: m[1].trim() } : { error: { status: 401, detail: 'Missing token' } } }];

parameters.query: select coalesce((select to_jsonb(p) from (select role, full_name from profiles where id = $1::uuid) p), '{}'::jsonb) as profile

with b as (select $1::jsonb as j, $2::text as tok, $3::jsonb as ctx, $4::uuid as id),
prev as (select c.id, c.name, c.slug, c.meta_ad_account_id, c.google_ads_customer_id, c.google_lsa_customer_id, c.ghl_location_id,
  c.avg_job_value, c.close_rate, c.gross_margin_pct, c.max_ad_cost_share, c.setter_fee_per_appt, c.default_service, c.trade, c.booking_system,
  c.meta_campaign_filter, c.meta_pixel_id, c.cpl_target_green, c.cpl_target_red, c.is_active, c.created_at from clients c, b where c.id = b.id),
upd as (
  update clients c set
    name = case when jsonb_exists(b.j, 'name') then (b.j->>'name')::text else c.name end,
    meta_ad_account_id = case when jsonb_exists(b.j, 'meta_ad_account_id') then (b.j->>'meta_ad_account_id')::text else c.meta_ad_account_id end,
    google_ads_customer_id = case when jsonb_exists(b.j, 'google_ads_customer_id') then (b.j->>'google_ads_customer_id')::text else c.google_ads_customer_id end,
    google_lsa_customer_id = case when jsonb_exists(b.j, 'google_lsa_customer_id') then (b.j->>'google_lsa_customer_id')::text else c.google_lsa_customer_id end,
    avg_job_value = case when jsonb_exists(b.j, 'avg_job_value') then (b.j->>'avg_job_value')::numeric else c.avg_job_value end,
    close_rate = case when jsonb_exists(b.j, 'close_rate') then (b.j->>'close_rate')::numeric else c.close_rate end,
    gross_margin_pct = case when jsonb_exists(b.j, 'gross_margin_pct') then (b.j->>'gross_margin_pct')::numeric else c.gross_margin_pct end,
    max_ad_cost_share = case when jsonb_exists(b.j, 'max_ad_cost_share') then (b.j->>'max_ad_cost_share')::numeric else c.max_ad_cost_share end,
    setter_fee_per_appt = case when jsonb_exists(b.j, 'setter_fee_per_appt') then (b.j->>'setter_fee_per_appt')::numeric else c.setter_fee_per_appt end,
    ghl_location_id = case when jsonb_exists(b.j, 'ghl_location_id') then (b.j->>'ghl_location_id')::text else c.ghl_location_id end,
    meta_campaign_filter = case when jsonb_exists(b.j, 'meta_campaign_filter') then (b.j->>'meta_campaign_filter')::text else c.meta_campaign_filter end,
    meta_pixel_id = case when jsonb_exists(b.j, 'meta_pixel_id') then (b.j->>'meta_pixel_id')::text else c.meta_pixel_id end,
    cpl_target_green = case when jsonb_exists(b.j, 'cpl_target_green') then (b.j->>'cpl_target_green')::numeric else c.cpl_target_green end,
    cpl_target_red = case when jsonb_exists(b.j, 'cpl_target_red') then (b.j->>'cpl_target_red')::numeric else c.cpl_target_red end,
    is_active = case when jsonb_exists(b.j, 'is_active') then (b.j->>'is_active')::boolean else c.is_active end
  from b where c.id = b.id and exists (select 1 from prev)
  returning c.id, c.name, c.slug, c.meta_ad_account_id, c.google_ads_customer_id, c.google_lsa_customer_id, c.ghl_location_id,
  c.avg_job_value, c.close_rate, c.gross_margin_pct, c.max_ad_cost_share, c.setter_fee_per_appt, c.default_service, c.trade, c.booking_system,
  c.meta_campaign_filter, c.meta_pixel_id, c.cpl_target_green, c.cpl_target_red, c.is_active, c.created_at
),
sec as (
  insert into client_secrets (client_id, ghl_token)
  select b.id, b.tok from b where coalesce(b.tok, '') <> '' and exists (select 1 from prev)
  on conflict (client_id) do update set ghl_token = excluded.ghl_token, updated_at = now()
),
res as (
  select to_jsonb(upd) || jsonb_build_object('has_ghl_token',
           coalesce(b.tok, '') <> '' or exists (select 1 from client_secrets s where s.client_id = b.id and s.ghl_token is not null)) as row
  from upd, b
),
aud as (
  insert into audit_log (actor_type, actor_id, actor_email, action, entity_type, entity_id,
                         client_id, before, after, request_id, ip, user_agent, environment)
  select 'user', (b.ctx->>'actor_id')::uuid, b.ctx->>'actor_email', 'client.update', 'client', b.id::text, b.id,
         (select to_jsonb(prev) from prev),
         b.j || case when coalesce(b.tok, '') <> '' then '{"ghl_token": "[redacted]"}'::jsonb else '{}'::jsonb end,
         null, (b.ctx->>'ip')::inet, b.ctx->>'user_agent', 'production'
  from res, b
)
select (select row from res) as data
